intent.kind: bugfix | feature | refactor | compat-data | perf | tests | docs | api | deps
intent.summary: One or two sentences: what the PR changes, in CSS terms (which syntax, which output).
claims: Each behavior the PR (title/body/tests) claims to change, one per entry.
intent.behind_flag: yes | no | n/a  (draft/one-engine syntax must be behind a ParserFlags/Features flag)

checklist.evidence: case id, probe id, file:line, spec URL#anchor, or command output. FAIL_PRE_EXISTING: a probe, base case or issue (#N) showing base fails the same way; it becomes a NOTE and never counts toward A1
checklist.note: one line; required on FAIL when the verify line offers alternatives (`… or …`): say why none holds. A FAIL citing a fixed or equivalent case of the mode the verify line accepts is rejected (A3)
checklist.effective_severity: optional: a lower severity when the item applies only marginally (never higher than the item's own)
checklist.severity_reason: required with effective_severity: why the item's severity does not fit this PR
checklist.finding: optional: id of the analysis finding this failure belongs to (e.g. F3); it folds into that finding as evidence

checklist.evidence: one answer for every unanswered item of a whole (non-general) checklist the diff does not reach

deltas.id: case id, a glob (`m-p-color/x-*`) or `source:<src>`. Entries match in file order and the first match wins. A glob may not clear a regressed case unless it is REGRESSION; a catch-all (`w-*`, `m-*`, `source:wpt`) must cover cases of one transition
deltas.classification: INTENDED | ACCEPTABLE_SIDE_EFFECT | REGRESSION | NEEDS_MAINTAINER_DECISION | ORACLE_NOISE | PRE_EXISTING
deltas.reason: one line; for ORACLE_NOISE say which tolerance/limitation; INTENDED/ACCEPTABLE_SIDE_EFFECT/ORACLE_NOISE on a case the browsers call different must cite the spec or WPT. Entries with the same classification and reason are reported as one finding
deltas.evidence: PRE_EXISTING only (or in reason): a probe, base case or issue showing base is wrong the same way. PRE_EXISTING yields at most a NOTE. REGRESSION needs base right where head is wrong; NEEDS_MAINTAINER_DECISION goes to the decision line and never makes the verdict UNSAFE
deltas.finding: optional: id of the analysis finding these cases are evidence for

findings.id: optional, unique (default F<n>, its position in this list); checklist answers and deltas link to it with `finding`
findings.title: imperative, one line
findings.detail: what is wrong and why, citing the spec or the browser evidence
evidence: case/probe ids, file:line, spec URL#anchor. Check failures whose cases are all cited here fold into this finding, which takes the worst severity of what folds into it
